title: Automatic model diagrams
text: model function, rxode2 model, rxode2 user interface object fitted nlmixr2 object can diagrammed. two-compartment model first-order absorption:  plot() rxode2 user interface object (compiled rxode2 model) draws diagram, equivalent: dosing compartment (depot, drawn heavy border) top feeds central compartment. peripheral compartment, exchanges mass central directions, left, elimination leaves central compartment downwards.
code: two.cmt <- function() {   ini({     tka <- log(1.5)     tcl <- log(3)     tv <- log(20)     tq <- log(2)     tvp <- log(40)     add.sd <- 0.2   })   model({     ka <- exp(tka)     cl <- exp(tcl)     v <- exp(tv)     q <- exp(tq)     vp <- exp(tvp)     d/dt(depot) <- -ka * depot     d/dt(central) <- ka * depot - cl / v * central - q / v * central +       q / vp * periph     d/dt(periph) <- q / v * central - q / vp * periph     cp <- central / v     cp ~ add(add.sd)   }) } modelDiagram(two.cmt, engine = "ggplot2") #> ℹ parameter labels from comments are typically ignored in non-interactive mode #> ℹ Need to run with the source intact to parse comments plot(rxode2::rxode2(two.cmt), engine = "ggplot2")

title: Automatic model diagrams
text: graph can drawn several ways, chosen engine: "DiagrammeR" draws interactive Graphviz widget ‘DiagrammeR’ package. default ‘DiagrammeR’ installed. "ggplot2" returns ggplot object can themed, saved ggplot2::ggsave() combined plots. needs extra packages. "dot" returns Graphviz DOT source string, edit render Graphviz tool. default engine can set per session: Arrows can labeled model terms drive :
code: modelDiagram(two.cmt, engine = "DiagrammeR") #> ℹ parameter labels from comments are typically ignored in non-interactive mode #> ℹ Need to run with the source intact to parse comments cat(modelDiagram(two.cmt, engine = "dot")) #> ℹ parameter labels from comments are typically ignored in non-interactive mode #> ℹ Need to run with the source intact to parse comments #> digraph model { #>   graph [layout = neato, splines = true, outputorder = edgesfirst, forcelabels = true]; #>   node [shape = box, style = "rounded,filled", fontname = Helvetica]; #>   edge [fontname = Helvetica, fontsize = 10]; #>   "depot" [pos = "0,1.1!", fillcolor = "#F2C57C", penwidth = 2]; #>   "central" [pos = "0,0!", fillcolor = "#7FB3D5"]; #>   "periph" [pos = "-1.67,0!", fillcolor = "#A9CCE3"]; #>   "depot" -> "central"; #>   "central" -> "periph" [dir = both]; #>   ".elimination4" [shape = point, style = invis, width = 0.01, pos = "0,-0.77!"]; #>   "central" -> ".elimination4"; #> } options(nlmixr2plot.diagram.engine = "ggplot2") modelDiagram(two.cmt, engine = "ggplot2", labels = TRUE) #> ℹ parameter labels from comments are typically ignored in non-interactive mode #> ℹ Need to run with the source intact to parse comments

code: g <- modelGraph(two.cmt) #> ℹ parameter labels from comments are typically ignored in non-interactive mode #> ℹ Need to run with the source intact to parse comments g #> nlmixr2 model graph #>  #> compartments: #>     name       role dosing #>    depot     dosing   TRUE #>  central    central  FALSE #>   periph peripheral  FALSE #>  #> flows: #>     from       to        type sign          label #>    depot  central    transfer    1     ka * depot #>  central   periph    transfer    1  q/v * central #>   periph  central    transfer    1  q/vp * periph #>  central (output) elimination   -1 cl/v * central plot(g, engine = "ggplot2")

title: Automatic model diagrams
text: d/dt() equation split signed additive terms (products distributed sums), : Mass transfer: term subtracted one compartment added, identically, another moves mass . order factors matter (ka*depot matches depot*ka), first-order, zero-order enzyme-driven rates recognized. Elimination: remaining loss contains compartment’s amount (like cl/v*central Michaelis-Menten vmax*C/(km + C)), depends compartment (zero-order loss). Input: remaining gain depends compartment: zero-order kin, self-dependent growth like kg*d/dt(). Interaction: term depends another compartment without moving mass, like effect compartment pharmacodynamic stimulation inhibition. drawn dashed. direction comes equation: inhibition term decreases driving compartment increases (including 1 - emax*C/(ec50 + C), kin/(1 + C) exp(-k*C) forms), stimulation increases, “modulation” direction determined. Intermediate variables (like cp <- central/v) followed, /else blocks ifelse() keep conditions, residual error lines ignored.

title: Automatic model diagrams
text: Compartments interact pharmacokinetic model without mass transfer go right, inputs outputs . indirect response (turnover) model drug inhibits production response:  transit compartment gut stacks dosing compartment central compartment. response zero-order input (kin) , elimination , dotted arrow center: drug inhibits response, PD decreases concentration increases. ‘DiagrammeR’ inhibition drawn “tee” arrow head: involved example, metabolite, two peripheral compartments, effect compartment response driven effect compartment:
code: pk.turnover <- function() {   ini({     tktr <- log(1)     tka <- log(1)     tcl <- log(0.1)     tv <- log(10)     poplogit <- 2     tec50 <- log(0.5)     tkout <- log(0.05)     te0 <- log(100)     prop.err <- 0.1     pdadd.err <- 10   })   model({     ktr <- exp(tktr)     ka <- exp(tka)     cl <- exp(tcl)     v <- exp(tv)     emax <- expit(poplogit)     ec50 <- exp(tec50)     kout <- exp(tkout)     e0 <- exp(te0)     DCP <- center / v     PD <- 1 - emax * DCP / (ec50 + DCP)     effect(0) <- e0     kin <- e0 * kout     d/dt(depot) <- -ktr * depot     d/dt(gut) <- ktr * depot - ka * gut     d/dt(center) <- ka * gut - cl / v * center     d/dt(effect) <- kin * PD - kout * effect     cp <- center / v     cp ~ prop(prop.err)     effect ~ add(pdadd.err)   }) } modelDiagram(pk.turnover, engine = "ggplot2") #> ℹ parameter labels from comments are typically ignored in non-interactive mode #> ℹ Need to run with the source intact to parse comments modelDiagram(pk.turnover, engine = "DiagrammeR") #> ℹ parameter labels from comments are typically ignored in non-interactive mode #> ℹ Need to run with the source intact to parse comments pkpd <- rxode2::rxode2({   C2 <- centr / V2   C3 <- peri / V3   C4 <- peri2 / V4   d/dt(depot) <- -KA * depot   d/dt(centr) <- KA * depot - CL * C2 - Q * C2 + Q * C3 - Q2 * C2 + Q2 * C4 -     kmet * centr   d/dt(peri) <- Q * C2 - Q * C3   d/dt(peri2) <- Q2 * C2 - Q2 * C4   d/dt(met) <- kmet * centr - kelm * met   d/dt(ce) <- ke0 * (C2 - ce)   d/dt(resp) <- kin - kout * (1 - ce / (ec50 + ce)) * resp }) modelDiagram(pkpd, engine = "ggplot2")

title: Automatic model diagrams
text: Binding unbinding recognized mass transfer binding partners complex (back):
code: tmdd <- rxode2::rxode2({   d/dt(central) <- -kel * central - kon * central * target + koff * complex   d/dt(target) <- ksyn - kdeg * target - kon * central * target +     koff * complex   d/dt(complex) <- kon * central * target - koff * complex - kint * complex }) modelGraph(tmdd, dosing = "central") #> nlmixr2 model graph #>  #> compartments: #>     name       role dosing #>  central    central   TRUE #>   target peripheral  FALSE #>  complex peripheral  FALSE #>  #> flows: #>     from       to        type sign                  label #>  central  complex    transfer    1 kon * central * target #>   target  complex    transfer    1 kon * central * target #>  complex  central    transfer    1         koff * complex #>  complex   target    transfer    1         koff * complex #>  central (output) elimination   -1          kel * central #>  (input)   target       input    1                   ksyn #>   target (output) elimination   -1          kdeg * target #>  complex (output) elimination   -1         kint * complex modelDiagram(tmdd, dosing = "central", engine = "ggplot2")

title: Automatic model diagrams
text: Dosing compartments detected dosing records data: fitted model data fit , models can supplied data. numeric named cmt values understood: data, first compartment (rxode2’s default dosing compartment) assumed. dosing compartments can also given directly:  fit, modelDiagram(fit) uses fitted model data:
code: d <- data.frame(   id = 1, time = c(0, 0, 1, 2),   amt = c(100, 50, 0, 0), evid = c(1, 1, 0, 0),   cmt = c("depot", "central", "central", "central"), dv = 0 ) modelGraph(two.cmt, data = d)$nodes #> ℹ parameter labels from comments are typically ignored in non-interactive mode #> ℹ Need to run with the source intact to parse comments #>      name       role dosing  x y annotation #> 1   depot     dosing   TRUE  0 1            #> 2 central    central   TRUE  0 0            #> 3  periph peripheral  FALSE -1 0 modelDiagram(two.cmt, dosing = "central", engine = "ggplot2") #> ℹ parameter labels from comments are typically ignored in non-interactive mode #> ℹ Need to run with the source intact to parse comments fit <- nlmixr2(two.cmt, nlmixr2data::theo_sd, est = "focei") modelDiagram(fit)

title: Automatic model diagrams
text: Dosing properties set model (lag()/alag(), f()/F(), rate() dur()) change flows, shown annotation next compartment (compartments without left blank). Initial conditions like central(0) <- 0 change diagram.  delay() keeps meaning delays: ka*delay(depot, tlag) destination still matches -ka*depot source (delayed transfer), delayed concentration driving effect keeps direction concentration.
code: pk.lag <- rxode2::rxode2({   d/dt(depot) <- -ka * depot   alag(depot) <- tlag   f(depot) <- fbio   d/dt(central) <- ka * depot - cl / v * central   dur(central) <- d1 }) modelGraph(pk.lag) #> nlmixr2 model graph #>  #> compartments: #>     name    role dosing           annotation #>    depot  dosing   TRUE lag = tlag; F = fbio #>  central central  FALSE             dur = d1 #>  #> flows: #>     from       to        type sign          label #>    depot  central    transfer    1     ka * depot #>  central (output) elimination   -1 cl/v * central modelDiagram(pk.lag, engine = "ggplot2")

title: Automatic model diagrams
text: Models written linCmt() converted ODE form rxode2::linToOde() diagrammed (requires version ‘rxode2’ provides ):
code: one.cmt <- function() {   ini({     tka <- 0.45     tcl <- 1     tv <- 3.45     add.sd <- 0.7   })   model({     ka <- exp(tka)     cl <- exp(tcl)     v <- exp(tv)     linCmt() ~ add(add.sd)   }) } modelDiagram(one.cmt, engine = "ggplot2") #> ℹ parameter labels from comments are typically ignored in non-interactive mode #> ℹ Need to run with the source intact to parse comments

title: Automatic model diagram — modelDiagram
text: layout follows common pharmacometric conventions: dosing absorption/transit compartments compartment feed; central compartment middle compartments exchanges mass (peripheral compartments) left; unidirectional transfer (e.g. metabolite) eliminations go ; compartments interact model without mass transfer (e.g. effect compartments pharmacodynamic models) go right, inputs , outputs exchange compartments right. Mass transfer drawn solid arrows; interactions without mass transfer dashed ("tee" arrow head inhibition "dot" arrow head direction undetermined DiagrammeR; dotted inhibition dot-dashed undetermined ggplot2). plot() rxode2 user interface (rxUi) object, like rxode2::rxode2(modelFunction), compiled rxode2 model draws model diagram, plot(rxode2(model)) modelDiagram(model). title: Build a compartment graph from a model's differential equations — modelGraph
text: differential equations parsed additive terms.  term subtracted one compartment added (identically) another mass transfer two compartments.  remaining subtracted term contains compartment's amount elimination (output); remaining term depends compartments interaction transport mass (example effect compartment pharmacodynamic stimulation/inhibition); remaining added term depend compartment (zero-order) input. Dependencies intermediate variables (like cp <- central/v) followed.  compartment drives transfer two compartments (like enzyme) drawn interaction destination.  Production loss driven another compartment (like ke0*cp effect compartment) represented interaction arrow alone, without separate input/output arrow.

title: nlmixr2plot 5.2.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-09-22 Added automatic model diagrams (#10). modelGraph() parses model’s differential equations (model function, rxode2 model/UI nlmixr2 fit) graph compartments flows (mass transfer, eliminations, inputs non-mass-transfer interactions like effect compartments PD stimulation/inhibition), detecting dosing compartments dosing records. modelDiagram() lays dosing absorption compartments central compartment, peripheral compartments left, eliminations/metabolites PD models right, draws "DiagrammeR" (Graphviz), "ggplot2" "dot" (DOT source) engine. Dosing properties (lag(), f(), rate(), dur()) shown annotations compartment, delay() terms understood. diagrams checked 3043 models ‘nlmixr2lib’, including large QSP/PBPK models. plot() rxode2 user interface (rxUi) object compiled rxode2 model draws diagram, new “Automatic model diagrams” vignette describes feature. Fixed vpcPlot() method = "tidyvpc" observed data observation records missing DV. records dropped observed data kept simulation, stratified (e.g. multiple-endpoint) VPC errored single-endpoint VPC paired simulated values wrong observations. matching simulated records now dropped (#74). plot() multiple-endpoint fit longer creates empty “Endpoint:” groups state compartments without observations (like depot central); observed endpoints plotted. plot() augPred() object likewise skips endpoints without data (#44). vpcPlot()/vpcPlotTad() multiple-endpoint fit whose data codes endpoints cmt longer shows extra NA panel (single NA panel pred_corr = TRUE); simulated compartment labels now matched observed ones name (#44). censored VPC (vpcCens(), vpcPlot() cens = TRUE vpc backend) multiple-endpoint fit now stratifies endpoints , matching simulated endpoints observed ones; endpoint whose observations missing longer becomes NA panel (#44). plot() censored multiple-endpoint fit longer errors geom_cens() (“argument must coercible non-negative integer”) endpoint without censored observations (#44). censored VPC (vpcCens(), vpcCensTad(), vpcPlot() cens = TRUE vpc backend) now honours data argument; previously always used fitted data, whatever data supplied (#55). observed data now comes original (supplied) dataset instead fit, censored records identified CENS column rather fit’s imputed DV (, censMethod = "cdf", land limit counted uncensored). Records without observation dropped, fit. VPC observed data now drops records MDV = 1 even EVID column also present (previously EVID checked existed). plot() augPred() object now accepts base-R style log argument (log = "y", "x" "xy") draw individual plots log-scaled axes; non-positive values, shown log axis, dropped (#32). vpcPlot(), vpcPlotTad(), vpcCens() vpcCensTad() now use supplied nlmixr2est::vpcSim() simulation instead discarding re-simulating default n = 300. Supplying n alongside simulation warns ignored, pred_corr = TRUE errors unless simulation created pred = TRUE (#57). observed-data prediction correction supplied simulation computed simulation’s fit rather whichever vpcSim(pred = TRUE) ran last. Fixed VPC simulation ignoring data argument vpcPlot(), vpcPlotTad(), vpcCens() vpcCensTad(); simulation always used fit’s dataset, match observed data built data (tidyvpc warned xsim match observed x-values). simulation now uses data supplied. supplied nlmixr2est::vpcSim() simulation made dataset, passing data alongside one now warns replaces observed data (#68). simulation now follows data, endpoint without observations data longer simulated either, drops multiple-endpoint VPC instead shown simulated-panel. model non-normal endpoint, data now needs numeric CMT column (model’s compartment numbers), since compartments otherwise taken fitted data row number, read factor’s level order, match data. Fixed prediction-corrected VPC (pred_corr = TRUE) ignoring data argument; observed data rebuilt fit’s dataset instead supplied data (#62). Fixed stratified censored VPCs (vpcCens()/vpcCensTad(), vpcPlot() cens = TRUE) failing “following specified stratification columns found observation data”; observed data now comes original (supplied) dataset, keeps stratification columns fit table drops (#56, #55). Fixed confidence-band width (legend label) vpcPlot()/ vpcPlotTad() tidyvpc backend; ci = c(lower, upper) passed tidyvpc::vpcstats() conf.level = ci[2] instead actual interval width ci[2] - ci[1], default ci = c(0.05, 0.95) (90% CI) drawn labeled 95% CI. Fixed vpcPlotTad()/vpcCensTad() (idv taken fit) user-supplied data subset reordering fitted data; tad merged fit row number, silently became NA (paired wrong row). supplied row now matched content fitted row came , warning given observations fitted data (#60).

title: nlmixr2plot 5.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-08-05 Fixed “object type ‘closure’ subsettable” error vpcCensTad() (vpcCens()/vpcPlot()/vpcPlotTad() cens = TRUE non-time idv); censored VPC now passes sim/obs column mappings vpc::vpc_cens() explicitly instead relying column guessing (nlmixr2#390). Fixed censored VPC confidence band, computed every simulated row replicate. simulated dv now mapped sim column instead copied new dv column, vpc groups simulated data replicate uncensored VPC. Fixed quantile() “missing values NaNs allowed” error prediction-corrected vpcPlot()/vpcPlotTad() censored (LLOQ/ULOQ) fits vpc backend; censored records now dropped pred-corrected VPC (shown non-censored data ), matching vpc package’s stated behavior (nlmixr2#390). Fixed prediction-corrected vpcPlot()/vpcPlotTad() method = "tidyvpc", cens = TRUE, previously errored observed data cens column; censoring column now retained observed dataset rebuilt pred-correction. plot() fit -subject variability (BSV) now adds nested "bsv" section (inside data/compartment group) QQ plots BSV parameter, BSV-BSV correlation plots (one BSV parameter present) , via new covariate argument, BSV--covariate plots (box--whisker categorical low-cardinality covariates, scatter plus linear trend confidence interval continuous ones). Covariate values taken subject’s first record, assumed time-invariant (#51). Plot collections returned plot() (fits augPred objects) now gglist objects ggtibble package instead internal nlmixr2PlotList class. still print/plot figures support broadcasting ggplot2 additions (e.g. plot(fit) + ggplot2::theme_bw()), top-level object remains named, nested collection (plot(fit)[["Endpoint: ..."]]). collection can also converted ggtibble reporting ggtibble::as_ggtibble(). Individual/augPred plots now paginated ggforce::facet_wrap_paginate(), removing hand-written 16-IDs-per-page chunking. Requires ggtibble (>= 1.0.3.9000) ggforce; minimum R version now 4.3. plot() fit (augPred object) now 3x faster. paginated individual plots expanded one-per-page ggtibble::as_gglist(), deep-copies plot serialize()/unserialize(); plots built inside functions hold whole fit, copy walked entire fit object. pages now produced re-adding paginated facet page instead. Removed obsolete rxode2::.linCmtSensB() test guards. internal removed rxode2 2025, try()/skip_if_not() checks always fell never skipped. linCmt() gradients now always available, guards unnecessary tests run unconditionally.
